text:
emma: Heads-up — I'm drafting 2.3.0 release notes for the docs site. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482. Need a quick pass for feature blurbs + Known Issues. Can folks skim? :eyes:
raj: On it. I'll focus on Dedicated + autoscaling bullets. Want short bullets or expanders?
emma: Short bullets with links; expanders for how-to/migration. Aim for 3–4 sentences per feature.
dara: Should we include the streaming tokens truncation bug under Known Issues? Happened on a few customer repros where streaming stops mid-response if network hiccup + fallback triggers.
liam: I saw that in SRE postmortem. Short repro + workaround would help (client should retry with non-streaming fallback). :bug:
emma: Can you paste a minimal repro and workaround here, Dara? We'll turn that into the Known Issues blurb.
dara: repro steps: 1) start stream call with SDK flag `stream: true` 2) interrupt network for ~2s 3) server fallback to compatible model triggers and stream ends. Minimal example:
```
# Python (requests streaming pseudo)
resp = client.chat.create(model="gpt-4o-realtime", stream=True, input="long prompt...")
for chunk in resp.stream():
    print(chunk)
# network drop -> stream ends early
```
Workaround: catch incomplete stream and retry with non-streaming call or set sticky routing to avoid fallback.
zoe: Minor docs nit: screenshot link on /console/overview is 404. Filed issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/679 — I can PR the updated screenshot path later. :camera_flash:
docs-bot: Deploy preview built for PR #482 — https://deploy-preview-482--docs.redwood.ai (expires in 7 days).
liam: I pushed two small commits to the PR: node and python SDK snippets updated for 1.0.0 signature change. See file changes in the PR.
emma: Important — add migration note for SDK 0.9 -> 1.0: param rename `model` -> `model_id` and streaming API shape changed. Short snippet for both languages please.
liam: Node snippet (added to PR):
```js
// old
await client.generate({ model: 'r-instruct-1', input: 'summarize...' })
// new
await client.generate({ model_id: 'r-instruct-1', input: 'summarize...' })
```
liam: Python snippet:
```py
# old
resp = client.generate(model='r-instruct-1', input='...')
# new
resp = client.generate(model_id='r-instruct-1', input='...')
```
emma: Perfect. Also adding a one-line note under Known Issues: "Streaming may truncate if network interruptions coincide with automatic model fallbacks — retry with non-streaming call or pin model version."
raj: For the autoscaling bullet, suggest: "Dedicated autoscaling now supports burst pools (beta) — see config snippet and limits." I can draft quick config JSON.
raj: Draft config snippet: `{"autoscale": {"min":2, "max":20, "burst_enabled":true}}`
dara: One more: add a short security note about KMS key rotations — docs need to mention upcoming change in rotation window (30 -> 7 days) and action items for on-prem customers. I'll paste a line.
dara: Security note: "KMS rotation window changing to 7 days for Private deployments. Customers using BYOK should reconfigure rotation schedules before 2025-07-01. See support article link."
zoe: I'll take the screenshot fix and the Known Issues link anchor updates. Planning to push before EOD.
emma: Quick checklist before merge: 1) feature blurbs (raj) 2) Known Issues entries + repro/workarounds (dara) 3) SDK snippets & migration note (liam) 4) screenshot/link fixes (zoe) 5) final proofread + deploy preview check (me). If all green I'll merge by tomorrow morning.
raj: LGTM, will drop comments in the PR. :thumbsup:
liam: quick question — should we call the release "2.3" or "2.3.0" in the header? Consistency with past posts matters.
emma: Use "2.3.0" in header, subtitle can be "June 2025".
docs-bot: Reminder: staging site sync runs at 02:00 UTC — if merged after that, preview might take until next cycle.
emma: Thanks all — ping me on PR thread if anything blocks. :sparkles:
